long_biography.plain_text:
Dimaş began in Istanbul in 1980 with the design, manufacture and installation of timber furnishings for large housing developments. Hotel and executive-office contracts broadened the operation, and by 1996 it had evolved into a construction, contracting and investment company.

Savaş Özgün's professional association with Dimaş sits within that mix of architecture and building activity. The company now works across industrial facilities, offices, housing, architecture, decoration and property appraisal. Its model combines design, project development and construction, while an in-house team of architects and engineers supports projects from planning through delivery.
